zh.principle: **攻击**：降级攻击（Downgrade Attack）。降级攻击指中间人把连接强行压到更旧的协议版本。TLS 1.3 把版本协商改为扩展：ClientHello 的「the legacy_version field MUST be set to 0x0303, which is the version number for TLS 1.2.TLS 1.3 ClientHellos are identified as having a legacy_version of 0x0303 and a supported_versions extension present with 0x0304 as the highest version indicated therein」。§4.1.3 进一步规定「TLS 1.3 has a downgrade protection mechanism embedded in the server's random value.TLS 1.3 servers which negotiate TLS 1.2 or below in response to a ClientHello MUST set the last 8 bytes of their Random value specially in their ServerHello」，TLS 1.2 情形写入哨兵字节 44 4F 57 4E 47 52 44 01，TLS 1.1 或更低为 …00。
zh.why: Finished 交换本身已能发现部分篡改，但版本回退需要更早、更明确的信号：§1.3 声明「A version downgrade protection mechanism is described in Section 4.1.3」，§4.1.3 则区分两类客户端：TLS 1.3 客户端「MUST check that the last 8 bytes are not equal to either of these values」，TLS 1.2 客户端则只是「TLS 1.2 clients SHOULD also check that the last 8 bytes are not equal to the second value」；一旦匹配，「If a match is found, the client MUST abort the handshake」，告警取 illegal_parameter，同时坦承「This mechanism provides limited protection against downgrade attacks over and above what is provided by the Finished exchange」，并指出「It does not provide downgrade protection when static RSA is used」。
zh.used: 禁止回退是一种标准做法而不只是实现细节。RFC 7568 写明「The Secure Sockets Layer version 3.0 (SSLv3), as specified in RFC 6101, is not sufficiently secure.This document requires that SSLv3 not be used」，并在 §3 规定「SSLv3 MUST NOT be used.Negotiation of SSLv3 from any version of TLS MUST NOT be permitted」，客户端「MUST NOT send a ClientHello with ClientHello.client_version set to {03,00}」，服务器同样不得应答该版本；TLS 服务器仍须接受 {03,XX} 作为记录层版本号，但「they MUST NOT negotiate SSLv3」。
zh.broken: 机制有明确边界：哨兵只要求「TLS 1.3 servers … MUST」设置，而只有协商 TLS 1.1 或更低时才是 TLS 1.3 服务器 MUST、TLS 1.2 服务器 SHOULD；静态 RSA 套件下不提供保护；客户端也必须真的检查这些字节。TLS 1.3 因此同时删除可被利用的旧能力：「The list of supported symmetric encryption algorithms has been pruned of all algorithms that are considered legacy」、「Static RSA and Diffie-Hellman cipher suites have been removed; all public-key based key exchange mechanisms now provide forward secrecy」，并移除压缩、DSA 与自定义 DHE 群；§6.2 的错误告警表列出 inappropriate_fallback（服务器对客户端非法重连尝试的回应，引用 RFC 7507），附录 C.3 的部署检查要求确认「all support for SSL, RC4, EXPORT ciphers, and MD5 … is completely removed」。
zh.history: RFC 7568 由 Barnes、Thomson、Pironti 与 Langley 撰写，2015 年 6 月发布为 Standards Track 并更新 RFC 5246；§4.1 给出理由：SSLv3 的 CBC 填充「trivially permits the recovery of plaintext [POODLE]」，RC4「exhibits serious biases and is also no longer fit for use [RFC7465]」，因此「This leaves SSLv3 with no suitable record protection mechanism」，§4.2 补充其密钥交换在重协商或会话恢复下易受中间人攻击。RFC 8446（Rescorla，2018 年 8 月）随后废弃了 TLS 1.2 的版本协商机制，改用扩展版本列表。

en.principle: **Attack**: Downgrade Attack (降级攻击). A downgrade attack lets an on-path adversary force a connection onto an older protocol version. TLS 1.3 moved version negotiation into an extension: "the legacy_version field MUST be set to 0x0303, which is the version number for TLS 1.2. TLS 1.3 ClientHellos are identified as having a legacy_version of 0x0303 and a supported_versions extension present with 0x0304 as the highest version indicated therein". Section 4.1.3 adds that "TLS 1.3 has a downgrade protection mechanism embedded in the server's random value. TLS 1.3 servers which negotiate TLS 1.2 or below in response to a ClientHello MUST set the last 8 bytes of their Random value specially in their ServerHello", using the sentinel bytes 44 4F 57 4E 47 52 44 01 for TLS 1.2 and the same prefix ending 00 for TLS 1.1 or below.
en.why: The Finished exchange already detects some tampering, but a version rollback needs an earlier and explicit signal: §1.3 states that "A version downgrade protection mechanism is described in Section 4.1.3", and §4.1.3 splits the duty: "TLS 1.3 clients receiving a ServerHello indicating TLS 1.2 or below MUST check that the last 8 bytes are not equal to either of these values", while "TLS 1.2 clients SHOULD also check that the last 8 bytes are not equal to the second value"; on a match "If a match is found, the client MUST abort the handshake" with an illegal_parameter alert. The same section admits that "This mechanism provides limited protection against downgrade attacks over and above what is provided by the Finished exchange" and that "It does not provide downgrade protection when static RSA is used".
en.used: Forbidding fallback is a standards-level measure, not an implementation detail. RFC 7568 states that "The Secure Sockets Layer version 3.0 (SSLv3), as specified in RFC 6101, is not sufficiently secure. This document requires that SSLv3 not be used", and §3 says "SSLv3 MUST NOT be used. Negotiation of SSLv3 from any version of TLS MUST NOT be permitted", that clients "MUST NOT send a ClientHello with ClientHello.client_version set to {03,00}", and that although servers must still accept any {03,XX} record-layer version number "they MUST NOT negotiate SSLv3".
en.broken: The mechanism has stated limits: the sentinel is mandatory only for "TLS 1.3 servers … MUST", while the SHOULD applies only to the TLS 1.1-or-below sentinel, which TLS 1.3 servers MUST and TLS 1.2 servers SHOULD set, static RSA suites get no protection, and clients must actually perform the check. TLS 1.3 therefore also removes exploitable legacy capability: "The list of supported symmetric encryption algorithms has been pruned of all algorithms that are considered legacy", "Static RSA and Diffie-Hellman cipher suites have been removed; all public-key based key exchange mechanisms now provide forward secrecy", plus the removal of compression, DSA and custom DHE groups. Section 6.2 lists the inappropriate_fallback alert, sent by a server in response to an invalid connection retry attempt from a client (citing RFC 7507), and the Appendix C.3 deployment checklist asks whether "all support for SSL, RC4, EXPORT ciphers, and MD5 … is completely removed".
en.history: RFC 7568, by Barnes, Thomson, Pironti and Langley, was published in June 2015 on the Standards Track and updates RFC 5246. Section 4.1 gives the reason: SSLv3's CBC padding "trivially permits the recovery of plaintext [POODLE]" and RC4 "exhibits serious biases and is also no longer fit for use [RFC7465]", so "This leaves SSLv3 with no suitable record protection mechanism", while §4.2 adds that the SSLv3 key exchange is vulnerable to man-in-the-middle attacks when renegotiation or session resumption is used. RFC 8446 (Rescorla, August 2018) then deprecated the TLS 1.2 version-negotiation mechanism in favour of a version list in an extension.

zh: 版本降级：把连接压回旧协议版本以利用其弱点。
legacy_version：为兼容旧实现而保留的版本字段。
supported_versions：列出实现支持的协议版本列表的扩展。
降级哨兵：写入服务器随机值尾部的特殊字节。
回退禁止：标准规定不得协商已被弃用的版本。
inappropriate_fallback：用于拒绝非法重连尝试的告警值。
en: Version downgrade: forcing a connection onto an older protocol to exploit its weaknesses.
legacy_version: the compatibility field carried for older implementations.
supported_versions: the extension listing protocol versions an endpoint supports.
Downgrade sentinel: special bytes written into the server random.
Fallback prohibition: a standard forbidding negotiation of a retired version.
inappropriate_fallback: the alert used to reject an invalid reconnect attempt.
